steps.text: Click "Add" — OptimCE first asks how you want to build the new allocation key.
steps.title: Start the creation

steps.text: Pick "Step-by-step wizard" — both modes produce the same key, but the wizard walks you through four steps instead of dropping you on a blank grid.
steps.title: Launch the wizard

steps.text: Indicate how many consumers will share the energy. This count drives the size of every iteration the wizard creates — three here.
steps.title: Number of consumers

steps.text: Click "Validate" to confirm the consumer count and proceed to the next step.
steps.title: Confirm the step

steps.text: Enter a name for each consumer. These names carry over to every subsequent iteration.
steps.title: Name the consumers

steps.text: Enter a name for each consumer. These names carry over to every subsequent iteration.
steps.title: Name the consumers

steps.text: Enter a name for each consumer. These names carry over to every subsequent iteration.
steps.title: Name the consumers

steps.text: Click "Validate" to lock in the consumer names and move on to configuring the iterations.
steps.title: Confirm the names

steps.text: Select "Prorata" for this first iteration: the energy will be split automatically between consumers based on their actual consumption.
steps.title: Pick prorata mode

steps.text: Enter the share of the available energy this iteration receives. The iterations must add up to 100%.
steps.title: Iteration weight

steps.text: The wizard sees the total is still below 100% and spawns a second iteration to configure. It will keep adding rows until the sum is reached.
steps.title: Next iteration generated

steps.text: Pick "Prorata" again for the second iteration so it uses the same automatic split logic.
steps.title: Prorata mode (iter. 2)

steps.text: Enter the remaining share: the iterations must add up to 100% to unlock the finalisation step.
steps.title: Complete to 100%

steps.text: Click "Validate": the total reaches 100% and the wizard opens the final finalisation step.
steps.title: Confirm iterations

steps.text: Give the new allocation key a name and a description. This metadata appears in the key list and makes the key easier to reuse.
steps.title: Name the key

steps.text: Give the new allocation key a name and a description. This metadata appears in the key list and makes the key easier to reuse.
steps.title: Name the key

steps.text: Submit the wizard to materialise the full grid: a review page opens so you can re-read the configuration before persisting it.
steps.title: Submit the wizard

steps.text: Click "Create" to save the key. The grid pre-filled by the wizard is sent to the CRM as-is.
steps.title: Save the key

steps.text: The new "E2E wizard key" shows up in the community's allocation keys list, ready to be associated with a sharing operation.
steps.title: Key created
